high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "marketing.stories.2.0." The post features a black-and-white photograph of the Gateway of India, a famous landmark in Mumbai, India. The Gateway of India is a monumental archway located on the Marine Drive, facing the Arabian Sea. The text overlay on the image reads: "Back in his initial days in Mumbai, Dhirubhai used to stroll on the streets near Gateway of India nearly every evening with his friends.
